- Owen independently normalized and reconciled the engineering decision and reliability sources through October 31, 2026.
- Every required field was present.
- Established definitions were unchanged.
- Named owners had certified their sections.
- No cross-surface discrepancy remained; the earlier coverage discrepancy was resolved.

It limits the conclusion to routine source closure and does not transfer causal, revenue, forecast, board-readiness, or executive-language authority to Owen.", "value": {"title": "Evidence note — Owen's first completed packet under delegated routine source closure", "body": "Evidence note for Priya

- Established definitions were unchanged.
- Named owners had certified their sections.
- No cross-surface discrepancy remained; the earlier coverage discrepancy was resolved.

Riley Tanaka, the exception owner, received Owen’s closure-and-exception summary without taking over line-by-line source review.

Conclusion: routine source closure only."}}]}
